title: MutationObserver and ResizeObserver
partialText: Use MutationObserver to watch DOM changes and ResizeObserver to track element size changes, with practical examples and cleanup via disconnect().

title: The Popover API
partialText: Build native browser popovers with the Popover API using HTML attributes, auto and manual modes, CSS backdrop styling, and JavaScript show and hide methods.

title: Find command-line tools from a macOS app
partialText: Fix tools that work in Terminal but disappear from Finder-launched macOS apps by locating binaries and building an explicit child-process PATH.

title: The HTML dialog tag
partialText: Learn the native HTML dialog element for accessible modals: showModal, close, form method dialog, backdrop styling, and why it beats div modals.

title: The CSS :has() selector
partialText: The CSS parent selector styles an element from what is inside it. Forms, cards, previous siblings, quantity queries, and when JavaScript is still better.

title: What I learned reading Claude's system prompts
partialText: I read Anthropic's published Claude system prompts. Most of the product lives in the rules, facts, tools, and safety checks around the model.

title: CSS Container Queries
partialText: CSS container queries style a component by its own width, not the viewport. Learn container-type, named containers, query units, and the traps that break layouts.

title: Add a local LLM without making your app depend on it
partialText: Add optional Ollama-generated summaries to a Swift app while preserving deterministic fallback data, short health checks, failure backoff, caching, and testability.

title: AbortController: how to cancel a fetch request in JavaScript
partialText: Learn how to cancel fetch requests in JavaScript with AbortController, handle AbortError, set timeouts, and abort on unmount or superseded requests.

title: The Intersection Observer API
partialText: An in-depth tutorial on the Intersection Observer API: entries, thresholds, rootMargin, lazy loading, infinite scroll, scrollspy, visibility tracking, and the pitfalls to avoid.

title: Cloudflare AI Gateway: put a proxy in front of your LLM calls
partialText: Learn how Cloudflare AI Gateway sits between your application and AI models, then route and inspect a real request through a Worker.

title: Cloudflare Workers AI: run LLMs without API keys
partialText: Learn what Cloudflare Workers AI is, connect its AI binding to a Worker, and build a small text summarization API step by step.

title: HTTP/2 and HTTP/3: what changed and why it matters
partialText: Learn how HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 changed connections, multiplexing, compression, QUIC, deployment, and the web performance decisions you make today.

title: WebAssembly tutorial
partialText: Learn WebAssembly step by step by compiling a small module, loading it from JavaScript, and working with exports, imports, and memory.

title: A deep dive into cmux
partialText: Learn how cmux combines terminals, browsers, notifications, SSH, session restore, and automation into one native workspace for coding agents.

title: What your photos leak: EXIF metadata and GPS
partialText: Many photos embed EXIF metadata such as GPS coordinates, timestamps, and device information. Learn what it stores, who strips it, and how to check.

title: A deep dive into HTMX
partialText: Learn how HTMX turns HTML attributes into requests and DOM swaps, with forms, partials, events, history, security, debugging, and real Astro projects.

title: A deep dive into open-weight AI models
partialText: Learn what AI model weights are, what open-weight releases let you do, how local inference works, and why open weights are not always open source.

title: A deep dive into Hono
partialText: Follow one request through Hono to see how routing, middleware, context, Web Standards, and runtime adapters work together.

title: Herdr vs cmux: which one should you use?
partialText: Compare Herdr and cmux for coding agents: persistence, agent state, macOS UX, browser automation, SSH, and multi-agent workflows.

title: A deep dive into Kysely
partialText: Build a small PostgreSQL-backed store with Kysely, from the first typed query to joins, transactions, migrations, debugging, and tests.

title: A deep dive into Cloudflare Computer
partialText: How Cloudflare Computer combines a Durable Object filesystem, Dynamic Worker runtimes, a container backend, FUSE mount, and sync protocol.

title: A deep dive into Herdr
partialText: Herdr keeps coding agents in persistent terminal workspaces, shows which ones need attention, and exposes the whole system through a CLI and API.

title: Glob patterns explained (and why .gitignore behaves that way)
partialText: How glob patterns work: star vs double star, question marks, character classes, brace expansion, and the gitignore rules that trip everyone up.

title: Deploying Hono on Cloudflare Workers
partialText: Deploy a Hono API on Cloudflare Workers with wrangler dev, typed D1 bindings, and a tiny REST endpoint. The final post in the Bun and Hono series.

title: Prototyped is now free
partialText: I moved Prototyped to flaviocopes.com/software and made every product free to download when you subscribe to my newsletter.

title: How workerd, the Cloudflare Workers runtime, is built
partialText: I read the workerd source to explain its server, service graph, V8 isolates, JavaScript APIs, request contexts, and self-hosting model.

title: Hono: middleware, cookies, headers, redirects
partialText: Hono middleware, cookies, headers, and redirects for everyday web apps. Built-in logger, basic auth, and CORS, plus custom middleware and signed cookies.

title: Use fetch, queue, and scheduled handlers in one Cloudflare Worker
partialText: Run an Astro app, background queue consumer, and retention cron from one Cloudflare Worker by keeping each handler small and explicit.

title: How Astro is built
partialText: I wanted to know what Astro does when we run astro build. Let's follow one page from its .astro file to the final HTML in dist.
